subject: [PATCH v2] mm: move LRU size stat updates out of lru_lock in folio batches

reviews.author: Shakeel Butt
reviews.summary:
The reviewer noted that the patch introduces a potential race condition between reparenting/offlining and stat updates, but considers it safe and suggested documenting this behavior change.

Gave Acked-by
reviews.raw_body:
This updating of stats after dropping the lru lock does introduce one behavior
change i.e. race between reparenting on offlining and stats update. I think it
is safe and correct though. Better to document it.

2026-10-29.patch_summary: This patch moves the updates of LRU size statistics out of the lru_lock critical section in folio batches, which reduces contention and improves throughput. The stats are accumulated while holding the lock and applied after dropping it, reducing the overhead of cache misses and improving performance. This change is particularly beneficial for workloads with many threads faulting and freeing memory in a single memcg, where the hold time of lru_lock directly limits throughput. The patch also moves cost_lock into the hole after lru_lock to make room for the batch pointer, keeping struct lruvec from growing. The stats may lag behind the LRU lists by one batch, but this is within the per-cpu batching already present.

reviews.author: Joanne Koong (author)
reviews.summary:
Author acknowledged that the swapoff path needs to drop the per-vswap spinlock before calling try_to_unmap(), agreed to restructure in v2.

Author acknowledged a need for additional documentation to address a race condition pointed out by reviewer Shakeel, promising to include it in the next version (v3) of the patch.
reviews.raw_body:

Thanks,

reviews.author: Joanne Koong (author)
reviews.summary: The author acknowledges a minor issue with the patch's interaction with memcg reparenting, and requests that additional text be added to the commit message to address this concern.
reviews.raw_body:
I'm seeing that the patch was picked up yesterday into mm-new. Could
you or Andrew add this paragraph to the commit message after the
"Accumulate the stats changes..." paragraph?:

"Applying the stats after dropping lru_lock means a batched update can
race with reparenting when the memcg is being offlined. This is ok
because updates to a dying memcg are redirected to its nearest
non-dying ancestor, which is where its folios end up after
reparenting."

Apologies for any inconveniences.

Thanks,
Joanne
